players.product: circuit protection (eFuses, TVS) and power semiconductors for datacenter power

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings release (Exhibit 99.1) and deck: within the Electronics segment, passive products sales grew 26% (+26% organic) and semiconductor products sales grew 16% (+15% organic), driven by increased protection and power semiconductor volumes; Electronics GAAP operating margin was 21.4% versus 14.9% a year earlier. In the Industrial segment the Basler acquisition contribution (+36%) was driven by strong grid and utility and data center infrastructure demand. Year to date, semiconductor products grew 13% (+11% organic).
